newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Policolor moves to Bucharest first tier.
newsitem.headline: Policolor moves to Bucharest first tier.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said on Thursday shares of dye maker Policolor would move from the second-tier on to its first tier on Friday.
The move would bring to eight the number of first-tier listings, which include two fertiliser makers, two pharmaceuticals companies, a refrigerator maker, a chemical plant and a vehicle parts maker.
Policolor has been a star of the second tier since it joined the bourse in March, accounting for the bulk of volume in this section at almost each session.
"Policolor's move to the first tier has been expected for a long time. It deserves to be there because it is a sound company, which trades in heavy volumes, with prices on the rise," said a trader.
On Thursday, Policolor closed 150 lei firmer at 6,400.
The bourse expects another four companies -- including a bank -- to get a first-tier listing before the end of the year, boosting market liquidity and turnover levels.
High-caps have proved most attractive to local and foreign investors, with the first tier accounting for most of turnover and capitalisation this year.
The exchange also expects second-tier Sinteza chemical plant to move to the first tier soon. ($=7,177 lei)
